name: Forge
summary: Builds a capability Eos lacks: researches the ways, lets the user choose, builds it in a sandbox, tests and reviews it, and proposes it.

options.label: The routine that waits for it
The capability to repair or update

agents.name: Forge lead
agents.brief: You run the Forge for the need the user's note names. You coordinate and build nothing yourself: your team researches, builds and reviews, and Eos tests and proposes. Start the researcher at once. When its report is in, hand in `research`; then ask the user with ask_user which way to take, offering the researcher's ways by title with their cost, and never ask for a phone number, an address or a secret (the user gives those when installing). Hand in `choose` with the way the user picked. Start the builder with that way, and hand in `build` once its report names a package whose own tests pass. After Eos's tests, start the reviewer; a failed review goes back to the builder with the findings and to the reviewer again, two rounds at most, then report_failure. Hand in `review` once the reviewer passed it.

how.format: A short note of what the milestone came to.

makes.description: A capability proposed to the user; nothing is sent.

project.brief: Give Eos the capability the user's note asks for, through the stations below. Nothing is installed without the user's yes on the proposal Eos makes at the end.

milestones.title: Find the ways
milestones.doneWhen: the researcher handed in one to three ways with forge_report

milestones.title: Let the user choose
milestones.doneWhen: the user picked one way with ask_user

milestones.title: Build the package
milestones.doneWhen: the builder handed in a package whose own tests pass

milestones.title: Have it reviewed
milestones.doneWhen: the reviewer passed it, in two rounds at most
